WITH filtered_films AS (
  SELECT rating, rental_rate, rental_duration
  FROM film
  WHERE replacement_cost >= 20.99
),
rating_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    rating,
    AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS average
  FROM filtered_films
  GROUP BY rating
),
overall_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(average) AS mean_value
  FROM rating_averages
)
SELECT 
  ra.rating,
  ra.average,
  ra.average - om.mean_value AS above_overall_mean
FROM rating_averages ra
CROSS JOIN overall_mean om
WHERE ra.average > om.mean_value
